name: Seiro (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Seiro town emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring with hooked strokes at the top, like the character 世.
history: Municipal flag of Seiro, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1977.

features.role: Seiro town emblem — a stylised device of a ring with hooked strokes at the top, like the character 世
